description: This file defines interfaces for warning reporting control and warning events within the WPEFramework. It contains pure virtual classes for handling warning events, reporting units, and control mechanisms, including functions for cloning, configuration, exclusion, and category management.

classes.name: WPEFramework::WarningReporting::IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface representing a warning event with serialization, deserialization, and classification capabilities.

classes.name: WPEFramework::WarningReporting::IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for a warning reporting unit responsible for reporting warning events and managing categories.

classes.name: WPEFramework::WarningReporting::IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Interface for control mechanisms specific to warning categories, allowing exclusion and configuration.

methods.name: IWarningEvent::~IWarningEvent
methods.description: Destructor for the warning event interface.

methods.name: IWarningEvent::Category
methods.description: Returns the category of the warning event.

methods.name: IWarningEvent::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the warning event into a byte buffer.

methods.name: IWarningEvent::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a byte buffer into a warning event.

methods.name: IWarningEvent::ToString
methods.description: Provides a textual representation of the warning event.

methods.name: IWarningEvent::IsWarning
methods.description: Indicates whether the event is a warning.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::~IWarningReportingUnit
methods.description: Destructor for the warning reporting unit interface.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event with a specific identifier.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Fetches information about a specific category, including its default status, enabled status, exclusions, and configuration.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a category control object to the category list.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control object from the category list.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl::~IWarningReportingControl
methods.description: Destructor for the warning reporting control interface.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl::Exclude
methods.description: Excludes a specified category from reporting.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl::Configure
methods.description: Configures the control with specific settings.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl::Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the control object.
